label: Core
scope: Shared participant identities, Artifacts, Collections and domain identities. Entities conform to the shared invocation profile.

label: Work
scope: Existing Todo family and other work concepts; no Work superclass.

label: Directory
scope: Directory concepts and contact information reuse Core participant identities. The remaining candidate inheritance paths are under review.

label: Request Management
scope: Requests and optional handling cases; service-specific workflows do not define universal taxonomy.

label: Vocabulary
scope: Shared status sets and values; optional SKOS sidecar.

label: Evidence
scope: Evidence content schemas reuse Artifact; no automatic class per schema.

label: Messaging
scope: Shared inbound and outbound information collections; application protocols and schemas remain bindings.
